proves.claim: jestWorktreeProblem, given a jest test script and a Jest config with no ignore entry covering the seat worktrees folder, returns one problem naming the entry to add.

cli.logic-jest-worktrees.unignored-names.why: Without it a Jest project's npm test scans the seat worktrees and reports hundreds of failed suites with no hint why (#11848).

proves.claim: a config whose ignore covers the seat worktrees folder, or a test script that runs no jest, returns no problem.

cli.logic-jest-worktrees.ignored-or-not-.why: Doctor must not flag a project that is already fixed or does not use Jest (#11848).
